name: Kawa Dumpling House
description: Kawa Dumpling House is a WordPress theme for a soup dumpling house with dine-in, takeaway and frozen packs across three branches. The front page uses a three-panel cover, sentence rows and a branch index with hours, basket prices and Friday restocks. Copy stays with the fold, the counters and the order-ahead cut-offs.
